item.title: What Is Biblical Discernment and Why It Matters
item.description: What is biblical discernment and why does it matter? In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how believers test everything by the Word of God and grow in spiritual maturity. Anchored in Hebrews 5:14 and 1 Thessalonians 5:21, this episode explores why discernment is essential for Christian maturity, protection from deception, and love for truth.
